name: android_batch_actions
description: Executes a sequential compound macro of actions (tap, double_tap, type, key, swipe, scroll, fling, pinch, rotate, sleep) locally in one shot.

actions.description: List of action maps. Each requires an "action" field plus per-type fields (defaults in parentheses): tap/double_tap: x, y (ratio when both <= 1.0, else pixels; intervalMs 120 for double_tap) — {"action":"tap","x":0.5,"y":0.5}; type: text — {"action":"type","text":"hello"}; key: keyCode (numeric Android keycode) — {"action":"key","keyCode":66}; swipe: startX, startY, endX, endY, durationMs (300); scroll/fling: direction (down), distance (0.6), speed fast|normal|slow (normal), durationMs; pinch: scale (1.5), centerX, centerY (0.5), durationMs (400); rotate: angleDegrees (90), centerX, centerY (0.5), radius (200), durationMs (400); sleep: durationMs (500) — {"action":"sleep","durationMs":800}.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
